products.title: Products
products.subtitle: The base products sellers order. Sellable combinations live under each product's variants.
products.empty: No products yet. Create the first one to start the catalogue.
products.dialogDesc: Sellable SKUs are added under Variants once the product exists.
products.fKeyHint: Used in URLs, the API and spreadsheet imports. Lowercase letters, digits and dashes.
products.fKeyHintLocked: Changing this breaks imports and API calls that reference the old key.
products.fThumbnailHint: Optional. Shown in tables and the catalogue.
products.errKeyTaken: Another product already uses that key.
products.delSafe: Nothing references this product, so it can be deleted. Its key stays reserved so it can never be reused by a different product.
products.delInUse: This product is in use and can't be deleted. Archiving hides it from sellers while keeping existing orders intact.

variants.title: Variants
variants.empty: No variants yet. A variant is a shared axis value like "Brown" or "Large".
variants.dialogDesc: A shared axis value like "Brown" or "Large". It becomes sellable once attached to a product.
variants.fKeyHint: Used in the API and spreadsheet imports. Lowercase letters, digits and dashes.
variants.fKeyHintLocked: Changing this breaks imports and API calls that reference the old key.
variants.errKeyTaken: Another variant already uses that key.
variants.delSafe: Nothing references this variant, so it can be deleted. Its key stays reserved so it can never be reused.
variants.delInUse: This variant is attached to products and can't be deleted. Archiving hides it from new SKUs while keeping existing ones intact.

mockups.title: Mockups
mockups.empty: No mockups yet. A mockup is the artwork an order is printed from.
mockups.dialogDesc: The artwork an order is printed from.
mockups.fUrlHint: Where the production file lives. Opened by the warehouse when printing.
mockups.fFolderIdHint: Optional. The source folder id, kept from imports.
mockups.delChecking: Checking whether orders use this mockup…
mockups.delSafe: No orders use this mockup, so it can be deleted outright.
mockups.delInUse: Orders were printed from this mockup, so it can't be deleted — they must keep resolving the artwork they were produced from. Deactivating hides it from new orders.

skus.empty: No SKUs yet. Attach a variant to make this product sellable.
skus.attachDesc: Each one becomes a sellable SKU for this product. Variants already attached aren't listed.
skus.bulkWarning: This replaces each SKU's whole tier table. A tier left blank here is removed from those SKUs.
skus.errBaseRequired: A base price (tier 0) is required — every other tier falls back to it.
skus.errSave: Those prices couldn't be saved. Check the format, e.g. 12.50.
skus.errSkuTaken: Another SKU already uses that code.
skus.errInUse: This SKU has orders and can't be detached. Deactivate it instead.

browse.title: Catalogue
browse.subtitle: What you can order, at your prices.
browse.empty: Nothing is available to order yet.
